workflow_inventory.source:
name: Verify Ledgerly
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  python-core:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: python -m pip install pytest
      - run: python -m pytest -q
  browser-engine:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: web-demo/package-lock.json
      - run: npm ci
        working-directory: web-demo
      - run: npm audit --audit-level=moderate
        working-directory: web-demo
      - run: npm test
        working-directory: web-demo
      - run: npm run build
        working-directory: web-demo
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install browser receiver dependency
        run: python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -r tools/requirements-browser.txt
        working-directory: web-demo
      - name: Receive sandbox ledger CSV in installed Chrome
        working-directory: web-demo
        run: |
          chrome_bin="$(command -v google-chrome)"
          "$chrome_bin" --version
          python tools/check_ledger_export_browser.py dist "$RUNNER_TEMP/ledger-export-receiving" --chrome "$chrome_bin" --emit-bundle
      - name: Receive unfinished intake files in installed Chrome
        working-directory: web-demo
        run: |
          chrome_bin="$(command -v google-chrome)"
          "$chrome_bin" --version
          node tools/check_intake_file_browser.mjs --browser "$chrome_bin" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/intake-file-receiving" --emit-bundle
      - name: Preserve intake file browser evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: intake-file-browser-receiving
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/intake-file-receiving/receiving-report.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/intake-file-receiving/*.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/intake-file-receiving/*.png
            ${{ runner.temp }}/intake-file-receiving/*.log
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14

name: invoice-record-browser
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'web-demo/**'
      - 'ledgerly/**'
      - 'fixtures/**'
      - '.github/workflows/invoice-record-browser.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'web-demo/**'
      - 'ledgerly/**'
      - 'fixtures/**'
      - '.github/workflows/invoice-record-browser.yml'
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: invoice-record-browser-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  receive-record:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # Resolved maintained v4.
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # Resolved maintained v4.
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: web-demo/package-lock.json
      - name: Install the existing locked project dependencies
        run: npm ci
        working-directory: web-demo
      - name: Build the actual staged Python browser application
        run: npm run build
        working-directory: web-demo
      - name: Require the installed system browser
        id: browser
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          INVOICE_RECORD_BROWSER=
          for INVOICE_RECORD_BROWSER_NAME in google-chrome google-chrome-stable chromium chromium-browser; do
            if command -v "${INVOICE_RECORD_BROWSER_NAME}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              INVOICE_RECORD_BROWSER="$(command -v "${INVOICE_RECORD_BROWSER_NAME}")"
              break
            fi
          done
          [[ -n "${INVOICE_RECORD_BROWSER}" ]] || { echo "An installed Chrome/Chromium is required."; exit 1; }
          node --version
          "${INVOICE_RECORD_BROWSER}" --version
          printf 'executable=%s\n' "${INVOICE_RECORD_BROWSER}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - name: Qualify Japanese glyphs in the installed browser's print environment
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends fonts-noto-cjk
          dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package} ${Version}\n' fonts-noto-cjk
          command -v fc-match
          INVOICE_RECORD_JP_FONT_FAMILY="$(fc-match --format='%{family}\n' 'sans-serif:lang=ja')"
          INVOICE_RECORD_JP_FONT_FILE="$(fc-match --format='%{file}\n' 'sans-serif:lang=ja')"
          printf 'Japanese font family: %s\nJapanese font file: %s\n' \
            "${INVOICE_RECORD_JP_FONT_FAMILY}" "${INVOICE_RECORD_JP_FONT_FILE}"
          [[ "${INVOICE_RECORD_JP_FONT_FAMILY}" == *"Noto Sans CJK JP"* ]]
          [[ -f "${INVOICE_RECORD_JP_FONT_FILE}" ]]
          dpkg-query -S -- "${INVOICE_RECORD_JP_FONT_FILE}"
          sha256sum -- "${INVOICE_RECORD_JP_FONT_FILE}"
      - name: Receive real Python invoice, actual HTML download and offline printing
        run: 'node web-demo/tools/check_invoice_record_browser.mjs --browser "${{ steps.browser.outputs.executable }}" --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/invoice-record-receiving"'
      - name: Preserve bounded native snapshots, downloaded files and print evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # Previously received official v4.
        with:
          name: invoice-record-receiving-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/invoice-record-receiving
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
          compression-level: 6

name: Publish Ledgerly browser demo
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: [ledgerly/**, fixtures/**, web-demo/**, .github/workflows/pages.yml]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write
      contents: read
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: web-demo/package-lock.json
      - run: npm ci
        working-directory: web-demo
      - run: npm run build
        working-directory: web-demo
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: web-demo/dist
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

name: receivables-browser
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'web-demo/**'
      - 'ledgerly/**'
      - 'fixtures/**'
      - '.github/workflows/receivables-browser.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'web-demo/**'
      - 'ledgerly/**'
      - 'fixtures/**'
      - '.github/workflows/receivables-browser.yml'
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: receivables-browser-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  receive-client-balances:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # Same maintained pin as invoice-record receiving.
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # Same maintained pin as invoice-record receiving.
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: web-demo/package-lock.json
      - name: Receive real native snapshots with the independent protocol
        env:
          PYTHON: python3
          LEDGERLY_RECEIVABLES_PEER_OUTPUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/receivables-peer/cases
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/receivables-peer"
          python3 --version
          node --experimental-strip-types --test web-demo/tests/receivables-peer.mjs 2>&1 \
            | tee "${RUNNER_TEMP}/receivables-peer/node-test.log"
      - name: Install the existing locked project dependencies
        run: npm ci
        working-directory: web-demo
      - name: Build the real staged Python browser application
        run: npm run build
        working-directory: web-demo
      - name: Require the installed system browser and built-in CDP client
        id: browser
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          RECEIVABLES_BROWSER="$(command -v google-chrome)"
          [[ -x "${RECEIVABLES_BROWSER}" ]]
          "${RECEIVABLES_BROWSER}" --version
          node --version
          node -e 'if (typeof WebSocket !== "function") throw new Error("Built-in WebSocket is required")'
          printf 'executable=%s\n' "${RECEIVABLES_BROWSER}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - name: Receive actual balances, native keyboard filters and session lifecycle
        run: >-
          node web-demo/tools/check_receivables_browser.mjs
          --browser "${{ steps.browser.outputs.executable }}"
          --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/receivables-browser"
          --emit-bundle
      - name: Preserve exact snapshots, screenshots and receiving logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # Same received official v4 pin as invoice-record receiving.
        with:
          name: receivables-receiving-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/receivables-browser
            ${{ runner.temp }}/receivables-peer
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
          compression-level: 6
